parent_child_scripts.trigger_point: Rushing during morning departures, putting on shoes, cleaning up toys.
parent_child_scripts.why_it_happens: The parent measures time in quick action steps. To the Earth child, sudden haste feels like an earthquake threatening their physical equilibrium, causing an immediate stubborn freeze.

word_for_word_script.step_1_pause: Stop barking instructions from across the room. Walk over and drop down to their eye level.
word_for_word_script.step_2_script: 'I notice my body is rushing and my voice is fast. That feels scary. I am going to slow down. We have 5 minutes. Would you like to put on the left shoe first, or the right shoe?'
word_for_word_script.step_3_physical_anchor: Place a firm, gentle hand on their shoulder to physically ground them.

parent_child_scripts.trigger_point: Meltdowns over seemingly irrational triggers (broken cookie, wrong cup color).
parent_child_scripts.why_it_happens: The Air parent tries to use logic ('It is the exact same cookie, just eat it!'). The Water child feels dismissed and unloved, escalating the crying storm into a full nervous system panic.

word_for_word_script.step_1_pause: Completely drop logic. Do not explain the situation.
word_for_word_script.step_2_script: 'You really wanted the blue cup. It is so hard when things do not happen the way our body expected. You can be sad. I am right here.'
word_for_word_script.step_3_physical_anchor: Open your arms without demanding a hug. Let them cry until their breathing naturally resets.

parent_child_scripts.trigger_point: Sudden outbursts, defying rules, running away in public spaces.
parent_child_scripts.why_it_happens: The Earth parent values calm compliance and predictable schedules. The Fire child feels physically caged by long sitting periods and expresses frustration through loud defiance.

word_for_word_script.step_1_pause: Do not threaten punishment or lecture while their adrenaline is high.
word_for_word_script.step_2_script: 'I see so much fire in your body right now. It is okay to be furious; it is not okay to throw blocks. Let's stomp our feet together or push this wall with all our strength.'
word_for_word_script.step_3_physical_anchor: Channel their physical adrenaline into heavy work (wall push-ups, stomping).
